title: These 30+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 9-13)
summary: Including six more Game Pass titles!

Manage Topics News Xbox Microsoft Xbox Series X Xbox Series S These 30+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 9-13) Including six more Game Pass titles! by Fraser Gilbert 7 hours ago Share: Welcome to your Xbox games roundup for November 9-13 ! We're really starting to feel the looming presence of GTA 6 now, but before we get there, the likes of Shrek 2 Remastered , Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition, Football Manager 27 and loads of Xbox Game Pass titles are all on the way to keep us busy! Here's what's coming to Xbox next week: On this page: These 30+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (November 9-13) 1. New Xbox Releases (November 9-13) 2. Xbox Game Pass Titles New Xbox Releases (November 9-13) Watch on YouTube Hozy (November 9): "Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again." Captain Coco: Treasure Island (November 10): "Join Captain Coco, a clever pirate monkey on a mission to crack open treasure chests by pushing coconuts across mysterious island levels." Football Manager 27 Console (November 10): "Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 Console is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call." Hard West 2 (November 10): "On the hunt for a big score, you hear talk that the legendary “Ghost Train” is heading your way loaded with federal gold. This is the one." Ova Magica (November 10): "Start a new life on an overgrown farm in the rural and peaceful Clover Town. You’re not alone this time—raise adorable blob companions that help you farm, explore, and make new friends." Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition (November 10): "RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding." Shrek 2 Remastered (November 10): "Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie." Tanuki: Pon's Summer (November 10): "Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI ’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it’ll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery." Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature (November 10): "Embark on an emotional adventure. Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles." Warhammer Survivors (November 10): " Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors’ game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions." Hope in the City (November 11): "Your sketches may be the only clues you have. Play as 17-year-old Hope Song in this narrative mystery set in Shenyang, China." Last Pirates: Die Together (November 11): "Grab your crew, grab the loot, and try not to lose your butt. Literally. Last Pirates: Die Together is a comedic online co-op adventure for up to 4 players." Mr. Toilet (November 11): "In Mr. Toilet, you’re more than just a janitor – you are the ruler of a public restroom. Who leaves with a smile, and who gets kicked out?" Thronefall (November 11): "Thronefall is a minimalist strategy game where you build a humble kingdom by day and defend it by night. Balance economy and defense by fortifying walls, recruiting troops, and charging into battle yourself to protect your stronghold from relentless waves of attackers." a pet shop after dark (November 12): "a pet shop after dark is a horror point-and-click adventure game where you’ve taken on an odd job at a little pet shop." Autobahn Police Simulator 4 (November 12): "Join the German traffic police and keep the roads safe in a fully drivable open world: unrestricted highways, winding country roads and lively towns." Croc's World 5 (November 12): "Croc's fifth adventure is a classic 2D platformer in the spirit of the great console and home computer games of the 80s and 90s: easy to pick up, challenging to master, and fun for players of every age." Fakin' It XL (November 12): "In Fakin’ It XL , players receive a simple instruction on their phone or device. Something like, “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Easy enough, right? Except one player, the Faker, never got the prompt and has to blend in like they know exactly what’s going on." Hazard Levels (November 12): "Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders." Hidden Squirrels (November 12): "Get ready for a charming hidden-object adventure in Hidden Squirrels! Explore beautifully detailed black-and-white scenes and search for adorable squirrels hiding in every corner." Hoop Shoot (November 12): "Take aim and land the perfect shot! Adjust your aim and power as you launch hoops onto poles across 50 challenging levels." Skygrid Courier (November 12): "Taxi passengers across a cyberpunk cityscape with speed and precision! Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision!" SONIC PICO PARK (November 12): "In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential!" Supermarket – Tidy Up! (November 12): "You brought your cat to work. Not a great idea: half the store is scattered across the floor, every shelf is empty, and the shop is supposed to open tomorrow morning." Weed Supermarket Simulator (November 12): "Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill store sim where you grow weed, develop new strains, set prices, and keep your shelves stocked." Derelikt (November 13): "Inspired by the mood and structure of System Shock 2, “Alien Resurrection” and Doom 3, DERELIKT leans into the dread of being under-equipped, out of your depth, and very far from help." Banker Simulator (November 13): "Take over a bankrupt bank in Banker Simulator, rebuild it from the ground up, and create your own financial empire!" BOMBANANA (November 13): "Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys." Cat Simulator (November 13): "Welcome to the ultimate playground of cute chaos. You step into the soft paws of a mischievous little kitten with one clear objective: turn every room into your personal playground of total destruction." DONGDA Gangster (November 13): "Dongda Gangster is a real-life interactive video game that combines hardcore underworld survival rules with multi-branching narratives, taking you to experience the underworld and get involved in the bloody fate of gang disputes." Dungeon Bricker (November 13): "Dungeon Bricker is an intense and exciting maze game. It’s a unique and interesting title where your focus is to try to move the player from wall to all or corner to corner in order to create a path of bricks and complete the level." House Cleaner Simulator (November 13): "Start small, but dream big. In House Cleaner Simulator , you’ll take on cleaning jobs in homes, offices, workshops, restaurants, and even luxurious mansions." Leaf Blower Co. (November 13): "Play through the full story of Leaf Blower Co., clear away clutter and bring back a world of peace and tranquillity. And of course, no-one expects you to do all of this for free!" Menes: The Chainbreaker (November 13): "Menes: The Chainbreaker is a challenging action-adventure set in an original world shaped by ancient mysteries, forgotten histories, and powerful beings bound by their own chains." Mr. Sticky’s Ragdoll Launch (November 13): "Help Mr. Sticky make his way through challenging physics-based levels filled with ropes, moving platforms, lasers, traps and deadly obstacles." QUTAS67 – Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067 (November 13): "Every criminal starts somewhere. You start in a dumpster. Welcome to Miami, 2067, where the economy is a joke and you’ve decided to become the punchline." Savoury Cascade (November 13): "Savoury Cascade is a Match-3 puzzle game that combines cooking, challenges, and managing a small café in a cozy experience." Ski Jumping World Cup (November 13): "Ski Jumping World Cup takes players to the world’s most iconic ski jumping hills, offering competition in both single player modes and online matches against opponents from around the globe." Author Profile Reply Comments 1 1 Fiendish-Beaver 6 hours ago I played the original Football Manger games when they first came out on a very basic PC (as they were back then), and played them for hours upon hours. I absolutely loved them. Something tells me I might have had the game on my ZX Spectrum too in the early 80s, but that might be my memory playing havoc with me as it often does these days, though in fairness, I am thinking back to over 40 years ago! Anyway, seeing Football Manager 27 coming to Game Pass in the next few days does give me the urge to give it ago to see if I can rekindle some old and fond memories. It would also then be the very first game I have played on Game Pass this year, which would be a bonus...! 0 Show Comments Leave A Comment Hold on there, you need to login to post a comment...
